verdict.rationale: Rev AI is a speech-to-text API service, not an agent or assistant that consumes tools. Plugging MCP servers into it as a client is outside its product category. The only MCP mention ('Install MCP server on Cursor') describes Rev AI's docs being served to Cursor, which is the server role, not Rev AI acting as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
